description: MagicBlock Devnet TEE validator workload measurements. Source of truth for the SDK is sdk/src/cards/tee.ts (MAGICBLOCK_DEVNET_TEE_MEASUREMENTS); sdk/test/cards-attestation.test.mjs keeps this file equal. Axum: CARDS_TEE_MEASUREMENTS = JSON.stringify(allowlist) (backend parse_measurements reads mrtd/rtmr0-2 and ignores the other keys).
provenance: confirmed by MagicBlock to ChainPay, 2026-10-04 (direct, unsigned)
rotation: On a validator upgrade: move the current entry to the end with label previous, pin the new values first with label current, drop previous once the old build is retired.
